business_domain: wholesale distribution; order-to-cash and lot traceability
organization_goal: deliver complete and traceable orders to retail customers

kpis.text: Order lines matching the customer purchase order

tasks: Capture customer purchase order with price list validation
constraints: A confirmed order cannot be edited without a change request

it_goals.text: Lot numbers traceable from receipt to customer

kpis.text: Shipped lines with lot number recorded
Time to list all customers of a recalled lot

tasks: Scan lot number at goods receipt
Record lot number on each picked line
beliefs: Suppliers print lot numbers on every carton
constraints: A line without a lot number cannot be shipped

rational_statements.text: Lot capture at receipt and picking makes a recall trace a query instead of a manual search, which is what the 4-hour KPI requires.

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: lot scanning slows picking and delays confirmation
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: confirm the order at entry and scan lots at picking, so confirmation time is unaffected
